note:
South Road on the 1901 census - one household of four, read from the enumerator's page and checked by A. Hagues.

Schedule 182 gives neither a house name nor a number, so the household is unfiled: **Elizabeth Lynam**, a widow of 71 living on her own means, her daughter Amelia of 44, and two servants.

The surname is worth noting against [[lynam-or-lynum-newcastle-court]], which turns on how that name is spelt and where the family sat.
source: 1901 census enumerator's page for South Road, Nottingham, transcribed by A. Hagues.
